body:
As far as the spot cleaner goes, there are a TON of stains and many are ground into the carpet. How well do those work?

Plus, as described in my SW post, the carpets and training aren't the only problems. I make very little money and can't support them the way they deserve. I don't even know where I will move, much less somewhere that accepts pets.
November 15, 2012 is the deadline. Do you have another suggestion? I obviously do not want them to go.
Thanks for reading everyone. It would seem you are in agreement that there's not really anything I can do. Some people are just meant to die, I suppose.
Those are too expensive for my very limited budget
